title: Core skips leading launcher flags (--sudo etc.) before computing subcommand
desc: Core's DispatchCommand walks past pre-command flags (--sudo, --stderr, --only-eye, --only-core) when locating the subcommand verb. Fixes 'Unknown command: --sudo' when user types wkappbot --sudo <subcmd>. --sudo preserved in restArgs for SudoHandler / ElevatedEyeProxy.
steps: 1. Symptom: wkappbot --sudo a11y invoke X -> Unknown command: --sudo (also a11y read, win-click).
2. Cause: Program.Dispatch.cs computed command = args[0].ToLowerInvariant() without skipping --sudo.
3. Fix: Program.Args.cs adds IsPreCommandFlag() allowlist; Program.Dispatch.cs walks until non-flag.
4. --sudo retained in restArgs so downstream SudoHandler.EnsureAdminForSudo / ElevatedEyeProxy still routes elevation.
5. Verify: wkappbot --sudo a11y invoke / read / win-click all reach proper handlers post-fix.
BUG REPORT cmds: a11y invoke / a11y inspect / a11y read / win-click ALL routed correctly post-fix when --sudo prefixes the subcommand verb.
author: claude
